---
title: "Untitled"
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
brand:
  logo:
    medium: https://quarto.org/quarto.png
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      # Leading `/` differs from Q1's original fixture: Q2 always passes
      # `--root` for typst renders, so mediabag-fetched paths come out
      # root-rooted here (see `typst_root_relative` in mediabag.lua).
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
      -
        - '#set page\(background: align\(left\+top, box\(inset: 0.75in, image\("/online-logo_files(/|\\)mediabag(/|\\)quarto.png", width: 1.5in\)\)\)\)'
      - []
